summary: Runtime row-average dispatch selects one of six width-specialized kernels (1–32 lanes) or the long-row kernel. Their source paths cover grid-stride rows and CSR entries, reduce lane sums and store outputs. Setup captures a bounded batch of full kernels; measured host replays the graph iterations/32 times and launches the remainder, then synchronizes. SASS contains all seven selected sm_86 variants, including the separate long-row worker.

Other complete source/device paths delegated to Luna.
